outgoing.name: Canada
outgoing.excerpt: A total of sixteen Martello towers were built in Canada, of which eleven are still standing.

outgoing.name: Florida
outgoing.excerpt: One was built in New Hampshire; others were built in Georgia, Florida, Louisiana and South Carolina.

outgoing.name: Genoa
outgoing.excerpt: Martello towers were inspired by a round fortress, part of a larger Genovese defense system, at Mortella Point in Corsica (see picture here).

outgoing.name: Russia
outgoing.excerpt: It was built to protect Sydney against the threat of a naval attack by the Russians during the Crimean War of the 1850s.

outgoing.name: Sri Lanka
outgoing.excerpt: Sri Lanka has one Martello tower, located at Hambantota.

outgoing.name: United States
outgoing.excerpt: The United States government also built Martello towers along the east coast of the US, copying the British design with some modifications.
